verdict.rationale: The only programmatic channel documented is the downloadable Batch Provider Software, which lets tax professionals submit payments for multiple clients outside the interactive website. Nothing shows it can run headlessly or inside a CI pipeline. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and sign-in requires interactive MFA via Login.gov or ID.me, which works against unattended automation. Missing for 10: a documented API or CLI, headless or non-interactive authentication, CI integration guidance, and any evidence that the batch software runs unattended.
